description: Defines the TwoFactorActivation class managing 2FA activation steps, verification, and UI state for a web application.

classes.name: TwoFactorActivation
classes.description: Manages the state and process of enabling two-factor authentication, including QR code generation, step transitions, and verification status.

methods.name: cancelActivation
methods.description: Cancels the activation process by invoking the provided cancel callback.

methods.name: openScanQRCode
methods.description: Transitions the activation step to 'scan-qr-code' if currently in 'save-secret-key'.

methods.name: openSaveSecretKey
methods.description: Transitions the activation step to 'save-secret-key' if preconditions are met.

methods.name: openVerification
methods.description: Prepares for verification by resetting input fields and setting step to 'verification'.

methods.name: openSuccess
methods.description: Transitions the activation step to 'success' if currently in 'verification'.

methods.name: setInputSecretKey
methods.description: Sets the secret key input value.

methods.name: setInputOtpToken
methods.description: Sets the OTP token input value.

methods.name: enable2FA
methods.description: Attempts to enable 2FA using provided inputs, updates verification status, and handles success or failure.

methods.name: finishActivation
methods.description: Completes activation by invoking the enabled2FA callback if in 'success' step.
